name: Orbit
notes: Single source. Every one of the 37 devices comes from the IC parts list in TM-127, and that is the only printing of this manual in the corpus that carries the list. No component-location drawing has been read. Nothing here has been checked against a second source, which is the test every other board on this site has passed, and the board page says so.

The grid spacing is nominal — the designators are what the parts list gives, but nothing has measured the board. Rows run R to A and columns 1 to 12; the row span is the standard Atari alphabet between the outermost letters seen, so rows with no device on them are still drawn as positions the board has.
conflicts: 3 device name(s) could not be recovered and are not placed: B12 (1324), E4 (8128), E6 (8128). Each is an OCR of a part number whose function number does not name anything the packaging table knows, and with only one printing there is no second reading to repair it from.
